stories.headline: Fort McCoy awards two timber contracts as next year’s harvest plan goes to review
stories.body: The Army reported November 12 that foresters at Wisconsin’s Fort McCoy awarded two new timber-sale contracts in October while managing three active sales. In September, three of four advertised tracts sold for a combined $96,357.

featuredResource.title: After Wood: Routes to Retirement
featuredResource.description: This book addresses retirement planning for loggers, foresters, sawmill operators and forest-products business owners. Its examples account for seasonal income and equipment-heavy businesses when considering savings and the transition out of work.
